body:
**CL term**
[CL_0001057](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0001057) — myeloid dendritic cell, human
[CL_0001058](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0001058) — plasmacytoid dendritic cell, human

**Suggested revision of class hierarchy**
Add: lacks expression of CD14
Although there were previous attempts to annotate DCs with CD14-negative expression (Issue [#123](https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/issues/123), [#125](https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/issues/125), [#127](https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/issues/127)), these were unfortunately closed without resolution.

**textual def**
please add in the textual def that this cell is CD14-negative.

**References**  **Add these references but do not replace exisiting references**

Relevant OMIP references demonstrating standard gating strategy:
1. [OMIP-77](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34260151/)
2. [OMIP-87](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36470845/)
3. [OMIP-94](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37254600/)
4. [OMIP-101](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38343094/)
5. [OMIP-112](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40095400/)


These human dendritic cell populations are consistently defined as CD14-negative in flow cytometry gating strategies. Although some tissue-specific DC subsets (e.g., dermal DCs) may express CD14, the general population of human DCs is gated as CD14⁻ to distinguish them from monocytes.


Thank you for your consideration.

comments.body: @dosumis, @addiehl There seems to be no progress since July, I would like to know the status.

@addiehl could you please check this out ? I agree with adding lack CD14 expression to "[CL_0001057](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0001057) — myeloid dendritic cell, human and [CL_0001058](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0001058) — plasmacytoid dendritic cell, human". However, I am not sure about adding it to the general human term [CL_0001056](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0001056) — dendritic cell, human as there are some human dendritic cells that do express CD14 (PMID: [23621371](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23621371/), [PMID: 34279540](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8292131/). Thank you

title: [Class hierarchy] Add "CD14 lacks" to human dendritic cell terms
